themes.title: Iran threatens Western leaders amid escalating tensions
themes.blurb: Iranian state media has published a 'revenge list' targeting Western leaders, including Italy's Giorgia Meloni and former U.S. President Donald Trump, following the death of Iran's Supreme Leader. This theme reflects a shared transnational reaction to perceived external threats, with right-wing parties across Europe and the U.S. rallying behind their leaders in a show of solidarity.

themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies in Europe
themes.blurb: Across Europe, right-wing and far-right parties are intensifying their focus on anti-immigration policies, often framing immigration as a threat to national identity and security. This theme highlights parallel policy debates in multiple countries, with parties like Germany's AfD, Spain's Vox, and Italy's Lega advocating for stricter controls and prioritizing national citizens in public services.

themes.title: Far-right leaders face legal and political challenges
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right leaders across Europe and the Americas are confronting legal battles and political scandals that threaten their legitimacy and electoral prospects. This theme captures parallel legal and political pressures in countries like France, Spain, Hungary, and Argentina, where leaders such as Marine Le Pen, Santiago Abascal, Viktor Orbán, and Javier Milei are navigating corruption allegations, judicial rulings, and internal party conflicts.

themes.title: Trump-Meloni feud escalates ahead of NATO summit
themes.blurb: The public feud between former U.S. President Donald Trump and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has intensified, with both leaders exchanging barbs over NATO commitments, Iran policy, and transatlantic relations. This theme reflects broader tensions within the right-wing transatlantic alliance, with other European leaders and parties taking sides or reacting to the fallout.

themes.title: Milei’s ‘shutdown’ policy sparks global right-wing emulation
themes.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei's 'shutdown' policy, aimed at drastically reducing public spending and government intervention, has sparked interest and emulation among right-wing and libertarian movements worldwide. This theme captures the transnational spread of Milei's economic ideology, with parties in the U.S., Spain, and Italy adopting similar rhetoric or exploring comparable policy approaches.
